newsitem.title: USA: Federal-Mogul to use proceeds to cut debt.
newsitem.headline: Federal-Mogul to use proceeds to cut debt.

text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp said Monday it expects to use proceeds from a proposed sale of its U.S ball bearing manufacturing operations to reduce debt.
The company, which distributes parts for cars, trucks, farm and construction vehicles, had long term debt at June 30, 1996 of about $472 million.
Federal-Mogul agreed to sell the assets and original equipment business if its U.S ball bearings manufacturing operations to NTN BCA Corp, a unit of NTN Corp of Japan.
Terms of the proposed sale will be disclosed at the completion of the transaction which is expected during the 1996 fourth quarter, a Federal-Mogul spokeswoman said.
Federal-Mogul said this agreement and a recently announced planned sale of an electrical products business substantially completes the company's divestiture plans for the foreseeable future.
Federal-Mogul had said it intended to sell the ball bearings operations in December 1995.
